ORDER Learned counsel for the appellant has filed a memo, which reads as under:
That the appellant has wrongly filed two appeals on the file of this Hon'ble Court and another appeal bearing MFA No.101038/2021 is already disposed off.
As such, the above appeal may kindly be disposed off as withdrawn to meet the ends of justice.
In light of the same, appeal stands dismissed as withdrawn.
